o.text: From Persian کلان (kalân). Doublet of kələntər (“sheriff”), via کلانتر (kalântar).
Borrowed from Russian термо́метр (termómetr), ultimately from French thermomètre.
Onomatopoeic. Equivalent to xor (“snoring sound”) + -ultu (noun forming suffix).
From rəng + -li. Cognate with Turkish renkli, Uzbek rangli.
Calque of Russian Дом культу́ры (Dom kulʹtúry, literally “house of culture”).
